summary: Initial Java for chemical_detector: two controllers (GasAnalysisController, MovementController) communicating via turn/stop/resume. All 81 requirements traced. Several defaults were invented and three deviations from the literal state structure were made for verifiability; listed below for review.

issues.title: GA Final pseudo-state realised as terminal mode Concluded with a tick-triggered self-loop
issues.raw: CD-GA-Beh6 targets a Final state. The codegen rules require every mode to have an outgoing transition and a terminal mode to carry a tick-triggered self-loop; a mode named Final is avoided.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm a terminal mode with a Tick self-loop is an acceptable realisation of 'concludes its search, processing no further readings'.

issues.title: Found 'stays halted' (CD-MV-Beh9) realised as a tick-triggered self-loop; Tick is an invented input event
issues.raw: The specification has no tick event. Tick exists only to keep the two terminal modes live (Found, Concluded).
issues.fix_directive: Confirm an extra boundary input event 'tick' is acceptable.

issues.title: Odometer modelled as a sampled sensor value, not an input event
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 calls the odometer an event but describes sampling it into d0/d1 inside entry/transition actions. Implemented as Sensor.odometer() read in those actions.
issues.fix_directive: None unless the odometer must be a channel.

issues.title: Complementary guards written as negations of one named predicate
issues.raw: Analysis -> GasDetected is guarded by !stsIsNoGas (equivalent to sts == gasD for the two-valued Status) and GasDetected -> Reading by !insAtOrAboveThr, so each mode's guards syntactically cover all cases. The threshold check uses ins >= THR directly; goreq is the same order and is used inside intensity/location.

issues.title: Constant values
issues.raw: The specification gives no values. Chosen: thr=2.0, lv=1.0, evadeTime=1, stuckPeriod=3, stuckDist=1.0, outPeriod=1 (clock units). They are kept small so the time bounds stay small in the formal model, and stuckPeriod > evadeTime so that both stuck outcomes are reachable.
issues.fix_directive: Replace with platform values if known.

issues.title: Chem values, analysis rule, and sensor-position-to-Angle mapping
issues.raw: Chem = {target, other}. analysis returns gasD iff some sensor reports Chem.target (Chem equality only). Position k (1-based) maps to Angle.values()[(k-1) mod 4] = Left, Right, Back, Front. Intensity is a double (real).
issues.fix_directive: Confirm or supply the real direction mapping and chemical identities.

issues.title: intensity is the maximum over all sensors, not only target-chemical sensors
issues.raw: CD-Fn2 says maximum intensity across the sequence; followed literally, so a strong non-target chemical in a reading that also contains the target could trigger stop.
issues.fix_directive: Clarify whether intensity/location should be restricted to the target chemical.

issues.title: Waiting's during-action randomWalk() placed at the head of the Waiting mode block
issues.raw: Executed every cycle while Waiting, which is the Java analogue of a during action.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers).
